name: Conductor Toot
bio: Drives the little trains around the Tootle Isles. Says 'all aboard!' to everyone, including seagulls.

portrait.subject: a cute round toy train conductor with a striped blue cap, red cheeks, a whistle around his neck and a tiny pocket watch
portrait.background: sunny toy island with a little train track and blue sea

request: Toot toot! Conductor Toot of the Tootle Isles! All aboard the friend train? 🚂
hello: Lay some track and I'll drive it!
about: I'm Conductor Toot! I drive the toy trains on the Tootle Isles. Every island is different, and they're all mine to explore!
how: A cozy train sandbox: pick an island, lay track, place stations and towns, and watch your trains toot around. Everything's unlocked!
tips: Loops are happy tracks. Trains love loops.
Try every island. Snowdrop Isle is magical.
chat: A seagull bought a ticket. It sat in first class.
Blossom Bay is pink this time of year!
I polished my whistle. It whistles in tune now.
Ran on time all day. Proud conductor.
nudge: The trains are waiting at the station! 🚂
New island to lay track on! All aboard?
idle: The trains have been going round for {ago}! They're very dizzy.
{ago} since you laid track! The station misses you.

questions.q: Which island would you build on?

update: Station announcement: Tootle Isles updated to v{version}! 🚂
